# BAD-063 — collab: a take recorded during a wrap can be refused and lost

## Brief
The membership gate completes an abandoned wrap on READ (collab/index.ts:655-674), mutating the in-memory collab row to status='wrapped' before any mode is dispatched. commit's own phase gate then refuses, because writablePhase() does not admit 'wrapped'. So the first take committed after the last hot seat stops recording is answered 403 closed and its row is never written — even though the member already uploaded the bytes through a signed URL, and even though the whole point of the 'wrapping' phase is that whoever is mid-part finishes. The same interaction makes commit's own wrap-completion copy (index.ts:1128-1145) unreachable outside a sub-millisecond race: whenever it would fire, the gate has already fired. BAD-047 must not change this in the split (the spike's risk 9 says leave both copies alone), so it needs a decision of its own.

Evidence: Pinned live in test/server/functions.test.mjs, 'collab: a wrapping room finishes on the next member read, and the take after that is refused' — against a local stack: heartbeat recording:false leaves status 'wrapping' (the beat is judged while the seat is still hot), the next info reads phase 'wrapped', and the next commit answers 403 {error:'closed',code:'closed'} with collab_takes still holding 2 rows. Reproduced independently by a throwaway probe before the test was written.
